newsitem.title: UK: Major to pick UK election date "in my own time".
newsitem.headline: Major to pick UK election date "in my own time".

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major refused to be drawn on the date for the next election and said in parliament it would be "in my own time".
"I'll pick the election date in my own time and not his," he said at prime minister's question time, referring to an opposition member of parliament.

Speculation on an early election has grown since Major's party lost its overall majority in parliament last week. The next election has to be held by May 22, 1997. Major said at the weekend it would not be later than May 1.
